newsitem.title: USA: Recovery Engineering Q4 loss widens.
newsitem.headline: Recovery Engineering Q4 loss widens.

text.p: Recovery Engineering Inc said Monday a net loss in the fourth quarter ended December 31 included a $1.5-million charge related to a facility relocation and legal fees in a patent infringement lawsuit.

The company reported a loss of $5.9 million, or $1.37 a share, compared to a loss of $4.0 million, or $0.95 a share, one year ago. Sales in the quarter reached $9.2 million, up from $5.9 million in 1995.

Recovery Engineering also said it is close to an agreement with a major bank for significant working capital and equipment financing. The company also received its first household products order from Wal-Mart Stores Inc and expects to ship the products in the first quarter.
Recovery Engineering develops small-scale drinking water systems. Its shares closed down 1/16 Thursday at 7.
